name: Beef protein isolate powder, unflavoured
identity: Plain, unflavoured and unsweetened beef protein isolate powder: hydrolysed beef protein isolate as the only ingredient. Flavoured and clear (fruit-drink) isolates are excluded.
rule: Per 100 g, each value is the median of the unflavoured labels below that declare it, and a value enters only when at least three labels declare it. Salt becomes sodium (salt in g × 400 = sodium in mg). Nothing a label leaves out becomes zero.

labels.read: Open Food Facts 0850079666306 through https://api.joinakari.com/v1/off/product/0850079666306; unflavoured, one ingredient, barcode 850079666306 on https://promixnutrition.com/products/grass-fed-beef-protein-isolate
labels.ingredients: Grass-fed beef protein isolate (one ingredient, unsweetened)
labels.serving: 1 scoop (31.1 g): 130 kcal, 0.5 g fat, 0 g carbohydrate, 30 g protein, 235 mg sodium
